title: Are LLMs Biased Like Humans? Causal Reasoning as a Function of Prior Knowledge, Irrelevant Information, and Reasoning Budget.

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLMs against human baselines on causal judgment tasks formulated as collider structures. The study elicits probability judgments under various prompt conditions (direct vs. Chain-of-Thought, semantic abstraction, and noise injection/overloading) to mathematically quantify specific human-like cognitive biases: 'weak explaining away' (EA) and 'Markov violations' (MV).
